en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town surrounded by open farmland. In the foreground there is a lumber yard with stacked timbers, sheds and some garden plots with laundry hanging on lines. Behind it stand several 2–3‑storey masonry houses with steep tiled roofs and simple historicist facades. Two tall brick factory chimneys rise among trees, suggesting light industry at the edge of the settlement. Larger institutional-style buildings are visible on the left, and long tree-lined field boundaries stretch into the distant flat countryside.
